metadata.name: Ember Five
metadata.author: Pedaleira
metadata.summary: A small single-ended amp: a 12AX7 input stage, the volume pot, a 12AX7 driver, a bass and treble tone stack (the middle is a fixed resistor) and one EL84 in class A with no global feedback, no master volume. The framework's power stage is push-pull; class A without crossover is the nearest it has, and the even harmonics of the single-ended stage come from the driver. A typical topology of the kind, not the schematic of one product; its values were fitted to measurements of a reference amp (its VOLUME sweep, its response with every knob at 5 and its tone knob sweeps). Every value the fit moved is marked "fitted" with what it was fitted to.
references: D. T. Yeh and J. O. Smith, the closed-form analysis of the treble, middle and bass tone stack, DAFx-06, 2006
J. Pakarinen and D. T. Yeh, A review of digital techniques for modeling vacuum-tube guitar amplifiers, Computer Music Journal 33(2), 2009

Pedaleira measurements of a reference amp played through a modelling unit's USB input: GAIN sweeps with a 1 kHz staircase, THD at the staircase's -18 dBFS step, the test signal's sweeps and the tone knob sweeps (2026), with the signal 24 dB under its nominal level
